content.title: Boudouaou Residential Development — 80 Homes
summary: An 80-home mixed residential development in Boudouaou, Boumerdes, combining 70 social housing units and 10 market-rate apartments with 10 ground-floor commercial and professional premises.
Three reinforced concrete blocks — two at R+8 and one at R+5 — were delivered under an all-trades contract including site roads and infrastructure.
description: The development is distributed across three blocks: Block A and Block B are each ground floor plus 8 upper floors (R+8), while Block C rises to ground floor plus 5 upper floors (R+5). Each floor plate is configured with four apartments per level, offering a balanced mix of F3 and F4 typologies.
The all-trades scope covered secondary trades, waterproofing, internal joinery, building services installations, and site roads and utility networks to fully integrate the mixed-use programme.
content.authority: A coordinated residential development where three structural blocks, commercial frontages, and site utility networks are executed as a unified urban delivery.

faq.question: What does the Boudouaou Residential Development include?
faq.answer: The development is an 80-home mixed residential scheme in Boudouaou, comprising 70 social housing units and 10 market-rate apartments across three structural blocks, with ground-floor commercial premises.

faq.question: What are the structural heights and block configurations?
faq.answer: The project comprises three blocks: Block A and Block B are each ground floor plus 8 upper floors (R+8), while Block C is ground floor plus 5 upper floors (R+5), with four apartments per floor throughout.

faq.question: What was the technical scope of the construction works?
faq.answer: The contract was executed under an all-trades framework, covering secondary trades, interior finishes, building services installations, and site roads and utility networks.

faq.question: How are the apartment layouts distributed across the blocks?
